verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is a 3D rendering and game engine library. It has no user-defined automations concept, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations falls outside this product category. Nothing in the evidence shows the product ships an automation feature that would make the axis applicable; the Playground is described only as an interactive code editor with sharing, with no versioning or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
